votes.motion: Enter into closed meeting for the purpose of attorney-client matters that are privileged pursuant to Utah Code 78B-1-137, and for other lawful purposes that satisfy the pertinent requirements of the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act.
votes.description: The Council voted to enter a closed session to discuss attorney-client privileged matters and other lawful purposes under the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act.
The Council voted to conclude the closed session and return to open meeting.
